login_interrupted: Sign-in didn't complete. Please try again.
login_locked: This account is locked. Contact IT to unlock it.
login_disabled: This account is disabled or expired. Contact IT.
login_expired: Your password has expired. Change it and try again.
login_throttled: Too many attempts. Try again in a minute.
login_no_method: No sign-in method is configured. Contact IT.
composer_placeholder_keyboard: Ask about your data… (Enter to send, Shift+Enter for a new line)
composer_locked_placeholder: Choose an option above to continue…
flows_subtitle: Automation flows composed by the assistant — ask for one in chat.
flows_empty: No flows yet — ask the assistant to create one in chat.
flows_none_selected: Select a flow on the left to see its graph.
attach_document: Attach a document (searchable by the assistant)
no_files: Nothing attached yet — use the paperclip in the message box.
download_failed: Download failed — is the server reachable?
settings_skills_hint: Playbooks the assistant learns after succeeding at non-trivial tasks: the exact procedure, pitfalls and verification steps. It loads them before similar tasks and refines them over time. Fully yours: review, edit or delete any of them here.
settings_skills_empty: No skills yet. They appear here when the assistant completes a hard task and captures how it did it.
settings_skills_desc_placeholder: One line: when does this skill apply?
settings_skills_share_hint: Send this skill for admin review — it activates for the chosen scope only after approval.
settings_skills_share_dup: A shared skill with this name already exists in that scope.
cap_embed_help: A public /embed page with anonymous, read-only access to the warehouse through a dedicated StarRocks service account. Everything visitors can see is exactly what that account is granted — scope it to curated views. No tools beyond SQL, charts and diagrams; no history is stored.
cap_embed_desc: Anonymous read-only chat page for embedding in internal portals (iframe).
cap_embed_not_configured: Set EMBED_STARROCKS_USER and EMBED_STARROCKS_PASSWORD in the environment.
cap_embed_status: Model {model} · {n} messages per conversation · {tokens} tokens/day shared budget
cap_email_help: Lets the assistant send branded HTML report e-mails with generated attachments (PDF/Excel) — only when the user explicitly asks, recipients restricted to the allowed domains, every send audited. The e-mail body comes from one tested template; the model never writes raw e-mail HTML.
cap_email_desc: The assistant delivers reports by e-mail (branded template + attachment) on the user's request.
cap_email_not_configured: Set SMTP_HOST, SMTP_USERNAME, SMTP_PASSWORD and SMTP_FROM_ADDRESS in the environment.
cap_sched_help: Programado: users schedule standing instructions the assistant executes automatically (daily/weekly/monthly). Runs are headless — they use the user's stored warehouse credential, spend the owner's daily token budget, are capped in steps and duration, and every run is audited. E-mail delivery inside runs still requires the report e-mails capability.
cap_sched_desc: Users schedule recurring analyses (Programado in the sidebar); the assistant runs them automatically.
sched_instructions_ph: Standing instructions executed on every run — be complete: tables, filters, output format, e-mail recipients if any…
sched_no_runs: No runs yet — the first fires at the next occurrence.
sched_delete_confirm: Delete this schedule and its run history?
embedkey_help: Per-portal access: each key carries its own StarRocks service account (stored encrypted, never exposed) and optional framing origins. The portal embeds /embed?key=… — a leaked key only reaches this guarded surface and can be revoked alone.
embedkey_created: Key created — copy it now, it will not be shown again:
embedkey_none: No embed keys yet — /embed uses the env service account, when configured.
embed_limit_notice: This conversation reached its message limit.
embed_welcome_sub: Queries run read-only against the data warehouse. Answers come as text, tables and charts.
org_skills_subtitle: Shared skills the assistants proposed — approve to activate for everyone in scope
admin_skills_pending_help: Skills a user's assistant proposed for shared use. They activate only after approval here — until then no other assistant sees them.
admin_skills_active_help: Approved playbooks injected into every matching user's assistant. Suspend to deactivate without deleting.
error_401: You need to sign in to see this.
error_403: You don't have access to this.
error_503: A service we depend on is unavailable right now.
greeting_1: Hi {username}, what can I dig into for you?
greeting_3: Ready to dive into the data, {username}?
greeting_sub_1: I can query the warehouse, chart the results, generate reports, search your documents, and use your connected tools.
greeting_sub_2: SQL queries, charts, Excel reports, Python analysis — just ask.
greeting_sub_3: Attach a spreadsheet, ask about your KPIs, or request a report.
login_preview_body: PerguntAI is in closed testing and {username} is not on the access list yet. Talk to the Analytics team to join.
settings_instructions_hint: PerguntAI will keep these in mind across all your chats.
settings_instructions_placeholder: e.g. keep explanations brief and to the point
settings_mcp_desc: Talking to the warehouse needs no connector — it is built in. Add your own MCP servers, each with its URL and token, to plug extra tools into your assistant.
settings_mcp_hint: Example — GitHub read-only: https://api.githubcopilot.com/mcp/readonly with a personal access token.
settings_mcp_enabled: Enabled — its tools are available in chat
apikeys_subtitle: Drive PerguntAI from your own scripts. A key acts as you: same models, same warehouse permissions, same token limit — revoke it here and it stops working immediately.
apikeys_usage_hint: OpenAI-compatible: point any client (openai SDK, LangChain, Open WebUI…) at this base URL. An empty model uses your default.
apikeys_scope_chat_hint: Data plane only: /v1 and chat — cannot read conversations or change settings.
apikeys_scope_full_hint: Acts fully as you: conversations, settings, documents, everything.
apikeys_new_hint: This is the only time it is shown — it is stored hashed and cannot be recovered.
apikeys_revoke_confirm: Revoke this key? Anything using it stops working immediately.
apikeys_error: Something went wrong. Please try again.
onboarding_welcome_body: Talk to your organization's data: SQL, charts, reports and Python — let's set up your experience in under a minute.
onboarding_profile_body: PerguntAI uses this to address you in conversations.
onboarding_connectors_body: PerguntAI works with your organization's platforms — the data warehouse, documentation, automations and more. Connections are set up later in Settings → Connectors, each with your own credentials.
settings_web_search_hint: Lets PerguntAI search the internet when the answer depends on current information.
settings_memory_hint: Lets PerguntAI remember durable facts about you across chats — your role, preferences, the terms you use. Off by default; everything it learns is shown here and deletable.
settings_memory_empty: Nothing remembered yet — PerguntAI will save topics as you chat, and you can add your own.
settings_memory_clear_confirm: Forget everything PerguntAI has learned about you? This can't be undone.
message_render_error: This message could not be displayed.
admin_org_prompt_hint: Applied to every conversation of every user, above personal instructions.
admin_open_mode: Empty list — anyone with valid credentials can sign in. Adding the first user switches access to allowlist mode.
admin_env_badge_hint: Defined in ADMIN_USERS on the server — cannot be blocked or removed.
admin_limit_title: Daily token limit — accepts 50k, 1.5M or 200,000; empty = unlimited
admin_sqlwrite_title: Let the assistant write to the warehouse (INSERT/UPDATE/DELETE/CREATE) using this user's own database permissions. DROP, TRUNCATE and ALTER stay blocked. Chat only — scheduled flows always stay read-only.
admin_org_console_hint: Standing instructions and shared knowledge for every user.
org_subtitle: Standing instructions and knowledge applied to every conversation, for every user.
org_users_subtitle: Who can sign in, their roles, grants and limits. Changes apply immediately.
org_stats_subtitle: Token usage across the deployment, today and this month.
org_policies_hint: Grant role, models, writes and limits by sign-in attributes (AD groups, cost center…). Grants add to the per-user list below; a per-user block always wins.
org_policy_empty: No policies yet — access is granted per user below.
admin_stats_multi_note: Users matching more than one department count in each, so the sum can exceed the total.
org_audit_subtitle: API keys, connectors and the activity log across the deployment.
org_capabilities_subtitle: Deployment-wide features — enable and probe platform capabilities.
cap_code_desc: Lets the assistant run Python for statistics, forecasting and analysis beyond SQL. Each run boots an isolated microVM (microsandbox) that is destroyed afterwards; warehouse data reaches it server-side under the requesting user’s own permissions.
cap_code_help: Requires the server to run microVMs: /dev/kvm on the host (or an MSB cloud backend). Beta — use the test button after enabling. Runs are capped in time and memory; the tool only appears in chats while this is on.
audit_keys_help: Every user's personal keys. A key is its owner: it inherits their live role, models and limits, so blocking the user disables their keys too. Revoking here takes effect on the key's next request.
audit_connectors_help: Which MCP servers and connector tokens each user has wired into their agent. Read-only — changes are made by each user in Settings and land in the activity log below.
audit_log_help: Who did what, when, from where: sign-ins (both doors), chat/API requests with their credential, admin changes, key lifecycle and connector changes. Click a row for the full event. Kept for 6 months.
admin_users_help: One row per person seen by the platform, whichever door they sign in through (SSO or password). 'Policy' rows have no individual record — grants come from the matching access policies; add an exception to set personal overrides. Grants add up; an individual block or limit always wins.
admin_policy_grants_hint: Defined by the matching access policies
org_general_hint: Behavioral guidance applied to every user, above their personal instructions.
org_general_placeholder: e.g. Always answer in Brazilian Portuguese. Values are in BRL unless stated otherwise.
org_kb_hint: Definitions and conventions the assistant should always know. Enable the ones to inject.
org_kb_entry_body_placeholder: What should the assistant know? Definitions, conventions, business rules…
org_footer_note: Keep entries to definitions and conventions — never data values a user couldn't query themselves. This text is shared with everyone.
org_docs_hint: Reference documents the assistant can search for every user (text and PDF).
org_dept_docs_hint: Reference documents the assistant can search for this department's members (text and PDF).
org_docs_visibility_note: Everyone in this scope can read these through the assistant. Text and PDF; scanned/image PDFs won't work.
org_dept_docs_save_first: Save the department first, then you can add documents.
org_dept_subtitle: Knowledge injected only for users whose sign-in claims match the rule.
org_dept_empty: No departments yet — add one to scope knowledge to a group of users.
org_dept_enabled: Enabled — matching users get this knowledge
org_dept_rule_hint: A user belongs when their sign-in claims — OIDC token claims or AD/LDAP attributes such as groups, department, title or e-mail — satisfy the rules below.
org_dept_rules_empty: No rules yet — this department matches nobody until one is added.
org_dept_yours: Your own sign-in claims — click one to add it as a rule:
org_dept_yours_empty: Your session carries no claims. Sign out and in again to load them.
org_dept_kb_hint: Injected only for users who match the rule above.
settings_mcp_token_pending: The token will be removed when you save.
